faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Accreditation & Ranking Executive position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIM Kozhikode Accreditation & Ranking Executive recruitment is 13th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Accreditation & Ranking Executive post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Accreditation & Ranking Executive post at IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree or a Four years UG Degree in Management/Science/Engineering to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any work experience required?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of two years of work experience after graduation is required, with a minimum salary of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Accreditation & Ranking Executive role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Accreditation & Ranking Executive post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Accreditation & Ranking Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Screening, a Selection Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIM Kozhikode website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a Contractual position at IIM Kozhikode.
